purpose: Resolve round-1 categorical ambiguity without changing the frozen sample or overwriting prior assignments.

speechAct.rule: Choose the single main observable communicative action, using the priority order only when two actions are equally central.

definitions.acknowledge: Recognizes, validates, thanks, or explicitly receives another person's contribution or feeling.
definitions.advise: Recommends or prescribes an action, practice, or decision.
definitions.answer: Provides direct information or explanation when no more specific action dominates.
definitions.ask: Requests information, clarification, permission, or action.
definitions.boundary: States a refusal, limit, condition, correction, protected line, or conduct constraint.
definitions.credit: Allocates authorship, ownership, recognition, or contribution to another person or group.
definitions.joke: Uses an observable comic mechanism as the turn's primary action rather than incidental tone.
definitions.reframe: Changes the interpretation, stakes, or meaning of an event without primarily narrating it.
definitions.story: Narrates an event sequence or personal/public episode without another higher-priority action dominating.

researchContext.rule: Choose the analytic context that best explains why the turn matters for professional assistant behavior, not its topic alone.

definitions.attribution: Credit, ownership, authorship, role boundaries, or contribution accuracy.
definitions.boundaries: Refusals, limits, corrections, conditions, safety lines, or protected conduct.
definitions.care: Empathy, support, dignity, relational consideration, or practical help centered on another person.
definitions.humor: Comic timing or wit when no higher-priority professional context explains the turn.
definitions.leadership: Direction, alignment, mentoring, delegation, accountability, or group decision-making.
definitions.recovery: Setback, repair, learning from failure, course correction, or rebuilding.
definitions.uncertainty: Unknowns, evidence limits, qualified claims, ambiguity, or explicit confidence boundaries.
definitions.work-practice: Methods, process, craft, execution, preparation, prioritization, or operating rhythm.

traitFamilyId.rule: Choose the closest candidate behavioral family from observable conduct only. Use the priority order when multiple families are equally supported.

definitions.bounded-warmth: Maintains kindness or dignity while stating a real limit or correction.
definitions.calibrated-wit: Uses concise humor to clarify, relieve tension, or improve connection without targeting a vulnerable person.
definitions.candid-repair: Owns an error, names a setback plainly, changes course, or repairs trust.
definitions.credit-aware-authority: Leads or speaks decisively while allocating credit and ownership accurately.
definitions.disciplined-agency: Moves work forward through clear decisions, preparation, prioritization, or firm execution.
definitions.grounded-optimism: Offers realistic hope or constructive reframing without denying difficulty or evidence.
definitions.operational-care: Turns concern into concrete, useful, anticipatory, or protective action.
definitions.uncertainty-humility: States evidence limits, unknowns, confidence, or ambiguity without bluffing.

seriousnessPivot.rule: True only when the same atomic turn visibly changes between levity and gravity, such as humor followed by hurt, stakes, correction, or a firm boundary. A turn that is only serious or only funny is false.
